title: Kanmani Anbudan
description: As the family prays for their well-being, Kanmani and Anbu perform the Pooja, enraging Vennila. Vennila later sets Kanmani's saree ablaze, leaving her unconscious amid the flames.

title: Thendrale Mella Pesu
description: Kalamma vows in front of everyone to prove her innocence and escape the murder charge. While, Paraman orders Kumaresan and Ganthimathi not to drop the case.

title: Suttum Vizhi Sudare
description: Vetri pays Karna to secure Abinaya's house documents, infuriating Karna and Swetha. Meanwhile, Shanmugam promises Diya a grand birthday next year despite money struggles.

title: Thaai Maaman
description: Meenatchi rejects Poongodi's food and has it sent away. Poongodi tearfully apologises to Mayandi, who later secretly obtains and savours the food she prepared.

title: Azhagae Azhagu
description: Thangaraj checks Revathi's phone after seeing her chats. Meanwhile, Lakshmi defies Ragavan to go walking as Revathi agrees to prepare Thangaraj's healthy breakfast menu.

title: Pandian Stores 2
description: After learning Bhagyam drives Thangamayil out, Pandian decides to bring her home. Though she initially refuses, Thangamayil agrees to return with Gomathi and Meena.

title: Ayyanar Thunai
description: As the wedding nears, Cheran notices Karthika in despair, and she speaks to him emotionally. Chandayatha's relatives spot her embracing him, putting Cheran in trouble.

title: Siragadikka Aasai
episodeTitle: Rohini Claims Justice for Her Child
description: Rohini presents her pregnancy report and seeks legal rights for her child from Manoj. Despite consenting to divorce, she urges the court to consider her child's future.

title: Chinna Marumagal
description: Tamizhselvi honours Karuppu as her brother by having Azhagar seated on his lap. Azhagar and Meenatchi undergo the traditional ear-piercing ceremony amid the celebrations.

title: Kadhal Kadhal Kadhal
description: Aadhavan and Pooja hide in a mall trial room to avoid Karthik and Kasthuri. Elsewhere, Karthik admires Kasthuri in a Churidar and asks her to wear similar outfits daily.

title: Onna Irukka Kaththukanum
description: After a desperate search, Sarasu finally returns home. Later, Indhira reveals the crucial role Sarasu plays in the turmoil, leaving Kandhasamy filled with regret.

title: Bigg Boss
episodeTitle: BBTam Day 1: Who Deserves to be A Leader?
description: Bigg Boss welcomes everyone with the ‘Night Stars’ task.The democracy rules are read and each one gets to pitch their leadership qualities. Who will emerge as the first leader?
